messages:
Leo: Published RCA for 2026-04-12 'eviction cascade' incident: <https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2520|RCA link>. Short summary: a chain of KV cache evictions during a maintenance window caused transient latency spikes and increased 5xxs for ~9 minutes. No customer data impacted.

Leo: Owners + asks below. Please confirm dates and blockers.

ACTIONS (owners):
- Implement eviction circuit-breaker and backoff (Amina) — plan + PR by 2026-04-16.
- Add per-tenant eviction metrics + alerting (Carlos) — instrument by 2026-04-18.
- Replay with maintenance and failover scenarios (eng-sre / Priya) — run by 2026-04-21.
- Exec note for ops digest (Leo) — draft ready by EOD.

Amina: Taking circuit-breaker. Will include a config flag and a short canary run.

Carlos: Adding tenant-level metrics. Will reuse existing shard labels and post dashboard mock by tomorrow.

infra-bot: Incident INC-35220 created and linked to RCA 2520. Owners: Amina, Carlos, Priya, Leo.

Priya: Scheduling replay: 04/20 07:00 PT. Need traffic sample from Leo.

Leo: Uploaded sample and maintenance steps: <https://internal.redwood.com/replays/serve-20260412|replay bundle>.

Priya: Will include induced maintenance window and verify p95/p99 behavior.

Carlos: Dashboard mock posted in #eng-infra. LMK feedback.

Amina: Opening PR today; tagging reviewers and adding unit tests.

Leo: Exec note draft: "On 2026-04-12, a maintenance-triggered eviction cascade briefly increased latency and errors for a small fraction of traffic. We've landed guardrails and are adding tenant-level monitoring; full verification is underway."

Priya: LGTM.

Carlos: +1.

Leo: Weekly follow-ups set through 2026-05-01. Please update INC-35220 with PR links and canary results. I'll close thread with action-closure summary once items are merged.
